text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and I are on our way back
to the
academy, when...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, my silhouette is framed by the
twilit sky,
intensifying my glow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So how can this be?! Look around you,
Trainer!

People, probably on their way home
from work,
are walking in and out of the
nearby train station.
They all look
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! My heart aches at the sight! Here
they are,
in the presence of the
Overlord, yet they all look
so
downtrodden!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I have come to a decision. I
will perform
an opera, at this very
moment!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My radiance, filled with affection, shall
become a
fountain, watering their wilted
souls!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will take the starring role, with you as
my
support!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! You are my trainer. We aim
for the
same glorious stage, do we not?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us begin the Evening Opera O Theater with full pomp and splendor!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hark, you people on the move! ♪ Why
must you
look to your feet?

T.M. Opera O glances my way as if to
say, "That's
your cue."

Mustering my courage, I pick up where
she left
off.
choice_data_list: オペラオーと歌うしかない！
オペラオーと踊るしかない！
choice_data_list_en: There's nothing for it but to sing with Opera O!
There's nothing for it but to dance with Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Open your eyes, lift your chin. ♪ And
you might
behold my glaring sheen.♪
choice_data_list: ららら～人生という旅に迷ったのさ～♪
choice_data_list_en: La la la~ I'm just a wanderer lost on the journey of life~♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am your shining light. ♪ I am your
guiding
light. ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look to me when it's all too much. ♪
Look to me
when you need a special
touch. ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will relieve your woe! ♪ Why? Because
I am...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The light that makes the world shiiine! ♪
choice_data_list: い、偉大なる“世紀末覇王”～♪
choice_data_list_en: T-The great 'Overlord of the End of the Century'~♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: T.M. ♪ OPERA OOOOO! ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With that, the curtain falls on the Opera
O
theater.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, my presence should be
ingrained in
your hearts forever more.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Please, think of me when the going gets
tough!
For I am watching over you all!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: I don't have a clue why, but seeing someone with that much confidence is... infectious!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well, time to get back at it! Thanks for
the lift!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At last, these empty husks have life
again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! All in a day's work—for I
am the sun
that brightens the spirit of
humanity!

I'm impressed once again by Opera O's
curious
charm, even if her sudden antics
are a constant
surprise.

Doing my best to recall her lessons, I
start
dancing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Nice footwork, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I cannot allow you to steal the
spotlight!
Haah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've the elegance of a swan! The might of
an
eagle!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let our dance bring hope to the people!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a clue why, but... I suddenly
feel like
dancing!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I think watching them just made me feel
a little
better!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh! The people have life in their eyes
once
again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...I must say though, I'm impressed you
kept up
with my dance to the end!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
These are the results of you basking in
my
presence day in and day out.
choice_data_list: 必死すぎて覚えてないけどな……
必死すぎて覚えてないけどね……
choice_data_list_en: I was trying so hard I don't even remember, though...
I was trying so hard I don't really remember, though...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, burn my image into your mind and
bring out
your talents to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not restrain yourself! Unleash!
Unleash!

Our special opera performance is over,
but we're
still the center of attention.

I'm impressed once again by Opera O's
curious
charm, even if her sudden antics
are a constant
surprise.
